subject: ADR-174: the food web's outputs, read -- the web export and the edge list byte for byte, the print held -- and a slash in a label is a label
body: THE BUTTON A TASK COULD NOT NAME. audit_outputs listed food-web next: Copy web export, Copy CSV, Print / save PDF, none read. The first two took a probe and an oracle; the third could not be named: @control:<name> reads a slash as host/label (ADR-128, rCov/4 is the dial labelled 4 inside #rCov), so Print / save PDF was host 'Print ' and label ' save PDF' -- a control that does not exist. The notebook's print button (ADR-173) was reachable only because it sits inside #p-more and p-more/Print / save PDF splits at the FIRST slash; the builder's has no host, and there was no way to write it down. find_control now tries the name WHOLE first (id, label, host) and reads it as host/label only when nothing answers to it whole: rCov/4 still scopes, Print / save PDF names the print button on any page that calls it that. verify_tasks 292 -> 293 (a hostless and a hosted print button side by side); mutate_tasks 65 -> 67/67 (a slash that always splits, a slash that never does). The task presses every export on the meadow and holds what left: Copy web export -> one clipboard payload BYTE FOR BYTE (the header, note: connectance 0.120 -- longest chain 5 levels, one note: <eater> eats <food> per link, twelve, in the order the meadow draws them); Copy CSV -> one clipboard payload byte for byte, food,eater then the twelve edges in the same order; Print / save PDF -> exactly one payload, a print; then the tiles and the export box read once more. verify_fw already carried a Python port of the meadow; it now builds the export and the edge list from that port and holds the TASK's literals to them -- swap one edge's direction in the task and the suite fails; 61 -> 64. food-web 0 -> 3 OF 3 OUTPUTS HELD, ceiling 3 -> 0; the kit's unread outputs 15 -> 12 of 66; the task 39 -> 54 confirmed, 0 refuted. Held: whole-name-first cannot steal a scoped name, since no page of the kit names anything with a slash except the print buttons; the export's link order is the preset's drawing order and the task holds it. No page was edited; eight pages still hand something over unread.
